shop.riga: B2B and B2C e-commerce for electrical and plumbing/HVAC supplies on Open2B, in four languages (IT/EN/ES/FR), turning over around €20,000 a day. I built the store theme from scratch and looked after its development and maintenance for almost two years.
shop.ruolo: Full stack developer · Punto Luce / EDIF · employee
compiti: New theme built from scratch on Open2B/Scriggo: home, product lists and pages, cart, customer area; mobile-first, dark mode, dynamic filters.

Three-step checkout and a one-page version, with conditional rules between payment and shipping methods: free-shipping threshold, non-EU countries, private and business invoicing; postcode autocomplete across 8,000 municipalities.

15+ PHP applications on the Open2B API: product feeds for Trovaprezzi and Kelkoo (Italy and France), automatic assignment of 50,000 customers to tax groups, cron-based receipt archiving, duplicate supplier-code check across 25,000 products, export of 60,000 orders, product descriptions generated with the OpenAI API.

20+ REST and webhook integrations: Brevo (58,000 contacts and 23,550 products in sync, real-time webhooks), Feedaty with Schema.org rich snippets, Doofinder, DocFinance, Facebook Graph API, sign-in with Google Identity Services.
Tracking via Google Tag Manager: GA4 e-commerce, Meta Pixel, Microsoft UET with enhanced conversions, Clarity; Cookiebot and Consent Mode v2 for GDPR compliance.
VAT number validation (Cerved and VIES) across 28 EU countries.
Performance and accessibility: LCP from 12 to 4 seconds, TBT down 40%, CSS cut from 15,000 to 10,000 lines; accessibility audit with WAVE and axe.
shop.strumenti: Open2B/Scriggo · PHP · JavaScript · HTML/CSS · REST APIs and webhooks · Google Tag Manager · GA4

osservatorio.riga: Public archive of migrant reception contracts in Italy, built from scratch: eleven years of public procurement cross-referenced with ministry data, browsable by province and year.
compiti: Collection and cleaning in Python of 18,104 contracts from three ANAC datasets, 2015 to 2025.
Parser for 90 ministry PDF reports (pdfplumber) with data on unaccompanied foreign minors, 2016 to 2025.
Aggregations by province and year, including the share of direct awards.
Static site in Next.js and TypeScript on Vercel; data updates automated with GitHub Actions.
Technical SEO and structured data; public code on GitHub.
osservatorio.strumenti: Python · pdfplumber · Next.js · TypeScript · GitHub Actions · Vercel

livellozero.riga: Editorial website about video games, built from scratch, with a custom CMS the client uses to publish on his own.
compiti: Built from scratch in Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript, deployed on Vercel.
Custom CMS: the client writes and publishes articles, uploads images and manages sections without technical skills.
Separate public site and admin panel.
Ongoing maintenance on an annual fee after delivery.

ndnluxury.riga: Next.js website of a resin and microcement flooring company in Legnano, serving private and B2B clients (restaurants, hotels, industry). I built new pages and handled organic search and content.
compiti: New pages and 3D animations.
Schema.org structured data (area served, service catalogue, FAQ).
“Read also” sections that pick related articles by a relevance score rather than by date.
Search Console analysis: CTR gap between desktop and mobile, pages with many impressions and few clicks to optimise.
Editorial plan, article revision, blog categories reorganised into four.
Setup of Meta and Google Ads campaigns targeted on the area, built on real searches.
ndnluxury.strumenti: Next.js, TypeScript, Vercel, JSON-LD, Google Search Console, Meta Ads, Google Ads

esh.riga: European platform that connects Erasmus students with verified landlords in several cities. I developed features in the Next.js codebase and coordinated the multilingual blog for organic search.
compiti: New pages and features.
Systematic check of the Italian, English and Spanish translations to find untranslated strings.
Blog article revision, internal links, brand terms consistent across languages.
Maintenance.
esh.strumenti: Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL (Neon), shadcn/ui, pnpm, Vercel
